_about: Cinematic look gates (CB 2026-11-10: 'apply all to knowledge'). Bands cut from five of Rick's films measured with tools/measure/cine_look.py's instrument on 2026-11-10 (references/remeasure/compare_2026-11-10/compare.json): Railroads, Roller Coasters, Drivers, Pink Prison, Storm Oil. 'films' keeps their values and our baboon film's so the bands can be re-cut. A FAIL is a value outside all five of his films.

vignette.fix: raise the vignette in the grade until the measured value is in range; fit per shot

shadow_b.target: -4 to -12 (four of his five films; MAIN LOOK -8)
shadow_b.fix: blue the fill light and the shadow side of the grade; shadows are never neutral grey or brown

haze.fix: pale the sky at the horizon, shorten the haze range so far things lift toward the horizon colour, add mist cards

top_bot.text: top third / bottom brightness (sky against ground)
top_bot.fix: the sky is too dark: lighter sky stops toward the horizon, sun glare in frame

hf.fix: denser ground cover near the lens (ballast, pebbles, grass), grain on big planes, less blur outdoors

spec.fix: gloss and a bright edge on the hero materials (rails, metal, glass, wet ground); a low sun makes them fire

litC.target: 20-30 on the big surfaces, one loud accent (Rick 16-30 in four of five films)
litC.fix: calm the big planes (ground, walls, sky) and keep the saturation for one accent colour

sharp.fix: outdoors keep deep focus (depth comes from haze and light); blur only behind close-ups; check motion blur is on travels only

L_spread.text: how much the light changes across the film (spread of L)
L_spread.fix: the film sits in one light: render the planned moods as real light and grade keys, and give the turn of the story its own light (dusk, night, shade, interior)

dark_p90.text: deep shade in the darkest tenth of the film, share of frame
dark_p90.fix: let one stretch of the film go dark: night, a shadowed canyon, an interior with one window

Ymean.fix: too dark or too bright overall: fit the grade gain

clip.fix: lower the bloom or the lamp strength
